docs.title: Practice Quizzes
docs.text:
Interactive practice quizzes. Each one opens in your browser, checks your answers as you go, and saves your progress on that device.

How to use these

Spell answers accurately and capitalize proper names. Punctuation and spacing are ignored when checking answers. Your work is saved automatically, so you can close the page and come back to it.

docs.text: Quiz Lesson Quiz 9 043 Test 3 — Quarter Exam 045

docs.title: History
docs.text: Grade 5 history practice. Spell answers accurately and capitalize proper names. Punctuation and spacing are ignored when checking answers. Complete the study questions and map review to unlock the multiple-choice quiz.

docs.title: Test 3 — Quarter Exam
docs.text: Lesson 45. Chapters 1–6, including geography. Textbook page references are included for each item.

docs.title: Language Arts
docs.text: Grade 5 language arts practice. Each question picks one of five practice versions at random, so Reset / Randomize gives a fresh set of problems for another try. Use Check on a question or Check All for a score; an answer can be shown after five wrong tries.

docs.title: Test 4 — Quarter Exam
docs.text: Lesson 42. Kinds of sentences, clauses, plural nouns, simple/compound/complex sentences, principal parts of verbs, kinds of verbs, subjects and predicates, and subject-verb agreement.

docs.title: Science
docs.text: Grade 5 science practice. Spell answers accurately and capitalize proper names. Punctuation and spacing are ignored when checking answers. Complete the study questions and self-review of diagrams and written responses to unlock the multiple-choice quiz.

docs.text: Lesson 42. Chapters 1–5. Textbook page references are included for each item. Diagram identification and written responses use self-review.
